# BE11 — Sports Platform Knowledge & LLM Discovery Index

> BE11 (https://be11.in) is India's sports ground reservation and athletic match management platform, operating in Faridabad, Haryana and the Delhi NCR region.

## Platform Summary
- **Organization**: BE11
- **Primary Domain**: https://be11.in
- **Operating Region**: Faridabad, Haryana, India (Delhi NCR)
- **Primary Sports**: Cricket, Football
- **Support Channels**: WhatsApp (+91 87001 90843), Email (support@be11.in)

## Verified Venues
- **RRR Cricket Club Kidawali Faridabad** (`/venues/rrr-cricket-club-kidawali-faridabad`)
  - Location: Kidawali, Pusta Road, Greater Faridabad, Haryana
  - Pitch: Natural Turf
  - Match Periods: Morning (06:00–10:00 AM), Afternoon (10:00 AM–02:00 PM), Evening (02:00–06:00 PM)
  - Pricing: Individual ₹299, Half Team (11 players) ₹2,600, Entire Venue ₹5,000 (with automatic promo code BE11 WELCOMES)
- **Playnow Cricket Ground** (`/venues/playnow-cricket-ground`)
  - Location: Bandhwari Road, Balola, Gurugram, Bandhwari, Haryana 122102
  - Pitch: Maintained Turf
  - Match Periods: Weekday Morning/Afternoon (₹5,000 whole / ₹2,500 team), Weekday Night (₹10,000 whole / ₹5,000 team), Weekend Morning (₹10,000 whole / ₹5,000 team), Weekend Afternoon (₹5,000 whole / ₹2,500 team), Weekend Day-Night (₹10,000 whole / ₹5,000 team), Weekend Night (₹11,000 whole / ₹5,500 team)
- **AB Cricket Ground** (`/venues/ab-cricket-ground`)
  - Location: New Industrial Town, near Aravalli Golf Course precinct, Faridabad, Haryana
  - Pitch: Turf Pitch
  - Match Packages: Standard Day Package ₹3,500 (includes umpires, scorers, match balls, nets); Extended Day / Floodlit Night Package ₹6,500

## Booking Workflow
1. Select verified venue from `/venues`.
2. Select desired match date on the calendar.
3. Choose match period (Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Day-Night, or Night).
4. Choose booking type (Entire Venue, Half Team, or Individual Slot).
5. Enter player contact details (Name, 10-digit Indian Mobile, Email).
6. Complete instant secure checkout via BE11 Wallet or Razorpay gateway.
7. Receive instantaneous confirmation in `/my-bookings`.
